newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells Jordan 150,000 tonnes of black barley.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells Jordan 150,000 tonnes of black barley.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has sold Jordan 150,000 tonnes of barley for November delivery, a senior GECPT official said on Monday.
He told Reuters the new contract would bring Jordan's imports of Syrian barley during the last six months to 350,000 tonnes.
The barley would be exported to Jordan by a joint Syrian-Jordanian transport company by road from the GECPT's stores in the Syrian city of Daraa on the border with Jordan, the official said.
He said agreement for the sale of the 150,000 tonnes of barley was concluded during a visit by the GECPT's deputy manager Adnan Shansuldin to the Jordanian capital on Sunday.
The GECPT official said the amount was separate from the 100,000 tonnes of barley that were offered in a separate tender for delivery in November and December.
October 16 was set as the final date to declare results of the tender, but no winners were announced as prices did not meet the GECPT's conditions.
